reference.operation: Layout/Sider share nineteen prepared tokens including three deprecated aliases. Root/header/content/footer, dark/light and zero/reverse/RTL Sider, global/component aliases and algorithms, lengths/zero/undefined, cssVar key/prefix, inherited CSS-variable root style, semantic/local/dimension priorities and nested/reset/sibling scopes. Explicit host font/line-height/color and rem size isolate document context. Standalone source sections are recorded separately as an observation, not a native conformance expectation.
reference.currentApiScope: Current API only: deprecated input profiles and output fields/declarations are excluded. Remaining measured values are retained.
